name: Reserved Kind: comment prefixes and the raw-comment guard
summary: reserved_comments.RESERVED lists every machine-record prefix (checkpoints, reviews, lifecycle, follow-ons, task files, ...); every version of each kind is reserved. check_comment_body and check_raw_request refuse a raw comment (HTTP comment route, endpoint bd comments add, --file transport, a BOM or CRLF lookalike) that starts with one, naming the structured operation to use instead; ordinary prose that mentions Kind: mid-text stays valid.
